title: Find customers who never ordered
prompt: Return the first_name and last_name of every customer who has no orders, sorted by first_name.
hints: Which join keeps a customer who has no orders?
After a LEFT JOIN, a customer with no orders has NULL in the order's columns.
LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.id IS NULL

wrongAnswers.misconception: Uses an inner join, which has already removed the customers it is looking for.
Keeps every customer and never asks for the unmatched ones.

feedback: A customer with orders must not appear, and a customer with none must. Check one of each in your result.
